Get Basketligaen Post-Game Team Stats

Source: R/sportality.R
sportality_post_game_team_stats.Rd

Post-game team comparison (2023/24 on).

Endpoint: GET https://www.basketligaen.dk/api/gameday/post-game-data/team-stats/{game_uuid}

Usage

sportality_post_game_team_stats(
  game_uuid,
  ssgt_uuid,
  home_team_uuid,
  away_team_uuid
)

Arguments

game_uuid

(required) Game uuid: gameInfo[].uuid of the schedule (10 lowercase letters and digits). Key space: platform game uuids; the Genius match id is extId / gameSourceId in the body.

ssgt_uuid

(required) ssgt uuid. Without it the answer is an empty 200 body.

home_team_uuid

(required) Home team uuid; without it the home side comes back blank.

away_team_uuid

(required) Away team uuid; without it the away side comes back blank.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Post-game team comparison (2023/24 on). An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the documented columns come first, in this order (sportsdataverse-py sportality_post_game_team_stats), then any column the API added later:

col_nametypedescription
home_team_side_translate_keycharacterTranslation key of the comparison row's label (s_2P, s_3P, s_FT, ...); the site translates it.
home_team_left_typecharacterStat code of the left value (2PM = two-pointers made).
home_team_left_valueintegerValue of the left-hand statistic of the comparison row.
home_team_right_typecharacterStat code of the right value (2PA = two-pointers attempted).
home_team_right_valueintegerValue of the right-hand statistic of the comparison row.
home_team_center_typecharacterStat code of the centre value (2PPerc = two-point percentage).
home_team_center_valueintegerCentre value (percentage as an integer 0-100).
away_team_side_translate_keycharacterTranslation key of the comparison row's label (s_2P, s_3P, s_FT, ...); the site translates it.
away_team_left_typecharacterStat code of the left value (2PM = two-pointers made).
away_team_left_valueintegerValue of the left-hand statistic of the comparison row.
away_team_right_typecharacterStat code of the right value (2PA = two-pointers attempted).
away_team_right_valueintegerValue of the right-hand statistic of the comparison row.
away_team_center_typecharacterStat code of the centre value (2PPerc = two-point percentage).
away_team_center_valueintegerCentre value (percentage as an integer 0-100).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in sportality_schedule().

 sportality_post_game_team_stats(
   away_team_uuid = "gvvuxe9ysw", game_uuid = "c4hh5nig6t", home_team_uuid = "rfo82vr830",
   ssgt_uuid = "xs07bd3fmp"
 )
